neighborhoods.name: Kreis 5 / Zurich West (Hardbrücke–Escher-Wyss–Technopark)
neighborhoods.rationale: Highest verified density of the actual builder crowd — Zurich AI Club ran multiple 2025 meetups at Beekeeper (Hardturmstrasse 181), Bluelion accelerator (Josefstrasse 219) hosts Falling Walls Lab and weekly startup events, Digitec Galaxus sponsored the Debug'Em All data meetup at Pause im Foifi (Förrlibuckstrasse 70), herHACK national hackathon and the Swiss {ai} Weeks 'Switzerland as Europe's Playground' panel ran at Technopark (Technoparkstrasse 1), and Impact Hub Viadukt (Viaduktstrasse 93) hosts CONDA pitch apéros and Zurich AI Festival sessions; adjacent Kreis 4 edge (Kalkbreite/Bäckeranlage) is where Cafe Cursor ran at specialty coffee bar slurp.

avoid_too: Bahnhofstrasse / Paradeplatz banking strip — too corporate, no dev-meetup culture, cafe rentals aimed at luxury retail events
Kraftwerk itself maxes at ~175 conference-style and books out far in advance for flagship events, so backup capacity is thin
Lake Side / Mythenquai side (AWS, SICTIC venue) is all corporate HQs, not a hackable cafe row
neighborhoods.name: City / Selnau (Kreis 1, Sihl riverfront by Bahnhof Selnau)
neighborhoods.rationale: Where the flagship 26–27 Sep 2025 Swiss {ai} Weeks Zurich Hackathon (350+ participants, Kickstart + ETH AI Center + Colosseum) actually ran at Kraftwerk (Selnaustrasse 25), which again hosts the 24–25 Sep 2026 edition and recurring events like Dare to Shape Tech and Founders Dinner; Kraftwerk is Impact Hub-operated with a cafe/restaurant for 80, a 175-person event space and coworking under one roof, and sits next to IHZ Colab + Café Auer & Co at Sihlquai 131 (the community's bilingual DE/FR/IT/EN home-base with weekly language lunch tables and Open Hub Day).

avoid_too: StageOne itself is a 1,000+ person convention hall — oversized and corporate-priced for a 50–200 person coffee/hack day
ETH AI Center OAT X11 is university-badge and partner-controlled, not publicly rentable
The Circle at the airport is hotel/convention territory — polished but culturally sterile for a hacker crowd
neighborhoods.name: Oerlikon (Kreis 11, ETH AI Center / StageOne axis)
neighborhoods.rationale: Where Zurich's flagship AI summits cluster — AI+X Summit (2 Oct 2025 and 1 Oct 2026) at StageOne (Elias-Canetti-Strasse 146), the ETH AI Center at Andreasstrasse 5 (OAT X11) hosts weekly research talks, the Zurich AI meetup's 'AI Tooling' session and the Zurich AI Festival's VC-in-Town / Women-in-AI programs, and kickoff events for the Humanoid Robotics World Championship run at the Oerlikon Robotics Arena; ETH Oerlikon OAT site and StageOne both support 100–500 person bilingual events.
